title: Grateful Dead Live at Baton Rouge International Speedway on 1969-09-01
taper: Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear)
source: Bear's Ampex Cassette Master > DAT > CD > WAV (provided by Anon)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the 1969 Baton Rouge show with a smoking Easy Wind and Lovelight, highlighted by solid Tom Constanten keys.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced soundboard audio that lets listeners hear Garcia’s powerful playing on Easy Wind and the soaring Lovelight, despite a brief loss at the start of Dark Star and a touch of distortion late in Lovelight. The performance is energetic and exploratory, with Tom Constanten’s keyboard work adding a unique 1969 flavor.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4‑5 stars, praising both the musical performance and the sound quality while noting only minor audio glitches; this yields a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear soundboard capture; minor issues include loss of part of Dark Star at the very beginning and slight distortion around 9:45 into Lovelight.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions, especially into Lovelight; the band explores each tune with an adventurous vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers a strong, 'Captain Trips' performance with standout solos on Easy Wind and Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten's playing is described as key‑laden and solid, adding an Iron Butterfly‑like texture to the show.
